name: Srinadh Kodali
headline: Plant & Soil Scientist translating field research, soil and crop data, and statistical analysis into practical agricultural decisions.
role: Postdoctoral Research Fellow · NDSU Dickinson Research Extension Center · Dickinson, North Dakota
about_heading: Research rooted in the field. Insights backed by data.
about_intro: I am an applied agronomist and plant scientist with a Ph.D. in Biological Sciences (Plant Science) and experience studying crop production, soil fertility, nutrient management, and soil–water–plant relationships across the Great Plains.
about_more: My work brings together multi-location field experiments, soil and plant measurements, environmental observations, and statistical analysis to address real-world crop management questions. I also enjoy communicating research through field days, demonstrations, and collaboration with producers and interdisciplinary teams.
research_intro: Applied studies connecting agronomic management with crop response and environmental variability.
extension: Field-day presentations on cover crops, nitrogen management, soil health, and crop production, translating plot-level findings for producers and agricultural stakeholders.
